title: What the Hounds Dug Up
text: All night the kennel hounds have been digging under the east wall. They have found something, and they will let no one near it. They will not stop whining.

options.label: Drive the hounds off and look at what they found.

outcomes.text: It is a child's skeleton, centuries old, wearing your House's colors. Nobody knows her name.
It is a chest of old coin, a hand still holding the key.

options.label: Fill the hole and chain the hounds; some things are buried for a reason.

outcomes.text: The hounds whine for a week, then stop. The old hound never eats again, and lies by the east wall until it dies.

options.label: Let the hounds have what they found; they dug for it.

outcomes.text: They eat whatever it was. Afterward they are bigger and quieter, and they watch the Scions.
They eat it. In the night they turn on the kennel master's apprentice.
